lines: Northern Virginia North Pokemon League meets at Continental Cards and is run by volunteer professors.

home.title: Northern Virginia North Pokemon League @ Continental Cards
home.lede: PLACEHOLDER A weekly trading card game league at Continental Cards, for players of every age and every skill level. Come to play, come to learn, come to trade.

items.heading: Find the desk
items.body: Look for the professor at the league table at the back of the tournament space. Let them know it is your first time.

items.heading: Give us your name, birth year, and Player ID
items.body: We will need your first name, last name, birth year, and your Player ID to get you signed in and playing in the correct age division. If you do not have a Player ID, we will get you set up with one.

items.heading: Bring a deck, or borrow one
items.body: Bring a deck with you, or borrow one of our rental decks. We encourage newer players to use a rental deck for their first couple of times, to get themselves acquainted with the current Standard format of the game.

items.heading: Play, and have fun
items.body: Every week you come, you will get a prize pack for playing, and earn prize points that you will eventually be able to use for items from the prize wall.

items.heading: Ask about our Trainer Card Program
items.body: Our Trainer Card Program is a program exclusive to our league. We would love to tell you more about it!

body: Continental Cards has a loyalty program for Northern Virginia North League attendees. By attending league weekly you can earn the opportunity to purchase newly released Pokemon TCG set products at MSRP.

Loyalty starts again with each new release. The threshold of weeks you need to attend to qualify to purchase different products may vary from set to set, so check back here to see the current thresholds.
